title: Have You Ever ‘Stolen’ A Kiss?
main_content:
The start of a new year is a time of reflection, or deep thinking. Many people feel nostalgic for the past. In other words, they think about the past in a dreamy way – a little happy and a little sad.

One popular New Year’s song is especially nostalgic.

Dan Fogelberg was a popular U.S. singer-songwriter. His song “Same Old Lang Syne” is set around the New Year.

When two former lovers meet in a grocery store, they talk about old times.

In the first part of the song, Fogelberg writes

Met my old lover in the grocery store, The snow was falling, Christmas Eve, I stole behind her in the frozen foods, And I touched her on the sleeve. Fogelberg did not actually steal anything from the store.

No, in this case, “to steal” means to do something secretly. You can steal a glance at your secret love. If someone steals a kiss from you, they surprise you with a kiss. If someone steals your heart, they cause you to fall in love with them.

questions.question: Who is Dan Fogelberg?
options: A contemporary artist known for pop music.
An influential U.S. poet and essayist.
A popular U.S. singer-songwriter known for his nostalgic songs.
A famous film director specializing in romantic comedies.
questions.answer: A popular U.S. singer-songwriter known for his nostalgic songs.

questions.question: What does “steal a kiss” mean?
options: To share a kiss openly in public.
To surprise someone with a kiss unexpectedly.
To express love through secret admiration.
questions.answer: To surprise someone with a kiss unexpectedly.

questions.question: When is the time for reflection?
options: At the start of a new year.
When one visits a grocery store.
questions.answer: At the start of a new year.
